articles.title: Germany's Lennart Karl ruled out of World Cup with muscle injury
articles.description: Germany forward Lennart Karl is ruled out of the 2026 World Cup with a thigh muscle bundle tear. Assan Ouédraogo called up as replacement.

articles.title: Iran players granted US visas before World Cup opener in Los Angeles
articles.description: Iran's World Cup soccer players have been granted visas to enter the United States, ending weeks of uncertainty. Team moves training base to Tijuana, Mexico.

articles.title: FIFA reverses water bottle ban - fans can now bring sealed bottles
articles.description: FIFA reverses course again, will permit fans to take 1 sealed water bottle each to World Cup games in the U.S. and Canada.

articles.title: Côte d'Ivoire stuns France 2-1 in World Cup warm-up friendly
articles.description: Côte d'Ivoire beat France for the first time in history with a stunning 2-1 win. Amad Diallo scored in the 83rd minute.

articles.title: Iraq draws with Spain after Merchas Doski's incredible strike
articles.description: Spain and Iraq drew 1-1 after a stunning goal from Merchas Doski. Spain took the lead through Ferran Torres.

articles.title: Lionel Messi 'doing well' and could play vs Honduras
articles.description: Argentina manager Lionel Scaloni says Messi is progressing well from hamstring injury and could play Saturday vs Honduras.

articles.title: New pre-match ceremony announced for World Cup 2026
articles.description: FIFA announces new pre-match ceremony where all squad players gather around center circle for anthems, not just starting XI.

articles.title: Rule changes confirmed: VAR expanded, time-wasting crackdown
articles.description: IFAB confirms rule changes for World Cup: VAR expanded to corner kicks, 10-second substitution limit, hydration breaks remain.

articles.title: Pochettino rules out Chris Richards vs Germany friendly
articles.description: US manager Pochettino rules out center back Chris Richards for Saturday's friendly vs Germany due to ankle injury.

articles.title: Neymar to miss Brazil's warm-up match vs Egypt
articles.description: Neymar will miss Brazil's warm-up vs Egypt as he recovers from right calf injury. No return date set yet.

articles.title: Ticketing error allowed fans to buy World Cup tickets for $0
articles.description: About 60 fans got World Cup tickets for free due to a system error. FIFA now demands they pay full price within 7 days.

articles.title: Paraguay star Julio Enciso injured in warm-up, World Cup in doubt
articles.description: Paraguay forward Julio Enciso's World Cup is in doubt after he was stretchered off during a 4-0 friendly win over Nicaragua.

articles.title: Messi vs Ronaldo - who is the greatest? Legends debate
articles.description: Some of the greats of the game debate the long-asked question: Lionel Messi or Cristiano Ronaldo?

articles.title: How thunderstorms could impact World Cup games in Texas
articles.description: With several host cities in peak thunderstorm season there is a high chance games could be disrupted by extreme weather.

articles.title: USA vs Paraguay preview: Everything you need to know
articles.description: USA face Paraguay in Group D opener at SoFi Stadium. Christian Pulisic leads USMNT against Gustavo Alfaro's defensive powerhouse.
